dct_description_sm:
This dataset represents the geochronological ages for selected Precambrian rocks in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada.  
  
  This dataset represents the compilation of geochronological ages for selected Precambrian rocks in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada.  **Please Note – All published Saskatchewan Geological Survey datasets, including those available through the Saskatchewan Mining and Petroleum GeoAtlas, are sourced from the Enterprise GIS Data Warehouse. They are therefore identical and share the same refresh schedule.
